description: Passes its single argument to another routine and returns. A thin wrapper with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:0E76
name: call_library_with_argument
description: Calls a library routine with its argument through a pointer at a fixed negative offset from the stored library base, then calls another routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:0E92
name: map_pointer_to_board_square
description: Converts a pointer position into a board square by searching two threshold tables of nine values each. Positions outside the board clear the selection. Choosing the square already selected toggles a flag, while a new square is recorded and passed to routine calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:0FC6
name: commit_pending_move_and_clear
description: Passes the saved source and destination squares to routines, clears both pending square fields and the stored flags, and clears the current selection when one is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1032
name: restore_pending_move_fields
description: Restores the saved source square, two stored flag values and a third working value from their saved copies, then calls another routine with the value 28.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1070
name: read_line_with_cursor
description: Reads a line of text into a buffer, showing an underscore cursor, accepting printable characters up to a fixed limit, handling backspace, and ending on the return key. Returns the length of the text entered.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:117C
name: prompt_for_minutes_to_think
description: Draws a box and the prompt Number of minutes to think, reads a line of digits, converts it to a number, and repeats until the value is between one and 10000. Returns the number.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:11F8
name: read_number_within_limit
description: Parses decimal digits from a line buffer and re-reads the line until the number is nonzero and below 10001, then displays a message and returns the number. Returns zero for negative values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:123E
name: read_number_within_limit
description: Reads a line of digits, parses it as a decimal number and repeats until the value is nonzero and below 10001. Displays a message and returns the number, or zero for negative values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1278
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1294
name: show_message_until_button_press
description: Draws a box sized to the message text, shows the message with a prompt to press the left button to continue, then waits for the click event before closing the box. Returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:13A2
name: wait_while_status_is_two
description: When one of two status fields holds the value two, it sends a message through another routine, sets a flag, and loops handling events until the status changes or an abort flag is set. Then it clears the flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:140E
name: clear_wait_flags
description: Clears one 16-bit wait field and one byte flag in the working block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:141A
name: read_and_send_command_line
description: Reads a line of up to 40 characters, ends it with a carriage return, shows it, and sends it through another routine. A line made of exactly three plus signs gets the same send call with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:14D0
name: send_fixed_command_string
description: Sends the characters A, T, E and a carriage return through another routine, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:14EE
name: show_opponent_quit_message
description: Shows the text Your Opponent just quit through a separate routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:151E
name: wait_for_menu_selection
description: For a player whose status is two, waits for a value to be set and returns it. Otherwise it draws a selection box, waits for a click inside a fixed horizontal range, and returns the entry chosen from the click position in 32-pixel steps.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1548
name: take_pending_byte_value
description: Returns the byte stored in a pending-value slot of the working block and clears that slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1558
name: choose_menu_option_by_click
description: Draws a four-option box, waits for a click inside its horizontal range, and returns the option chosen from the click position in 32-pixel steps.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1560
name: choose_menu_option_by_click
description: Draws a four-option box, waits for a click inside its horizontal range, and returns the option chosen from the click position in 32-pixel steps.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:156E
name: choose_pawn_promotion_piece
description: Shows the question Promote pawn to? with a row of four piece options, waits for a click inside the option range, and returns the chosen option from the click position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:16B0
name: wait_for_click_in_region
description: Waits for a click inside a fixed horizontal and vertical range, then returns an entry from a table indexed by the click position in 32-pixel steps.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1722
name: draw_nested_rectangles
description: Draws a filled rectangle from four coordinate arguments in the given colour, then draws three outlines inset one unit at a time, each in a successively lower colour index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:17D2
name: draw_piece_sprite_if_changed
description: When the stored piece code differs from the argument, updates the stored code and draws the matching piece image from a table at a position chosen by the code, with an offset adjustment for one special code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:183E
name: setup_board_display_buffers
description: Carves the display memory from one block: a 40000-byte area, piece-image slots, screen rows and table entries. Then it sets up the display pointers, loads the initial images and draws the initial board.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1A20
name: assign_image_buffer_pointers
description: Stores pointers to two image-buffer areas in the working block, and a second pointer for each one offset by 264 and 60 bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1A70
name: initialize_board_state_tables
description: Clears six state bytes and sets eight more to 255, then assigns a pointer table and draws the board image through library calls. The table set depends on whether a stored flag is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1B46
name: select_board_pointer_table
description: Draws the board image through library calls, assigns a set of five pointers in the working block, then finishes with a library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1BCE
name: copy_and_xor_image_buffer
description: Loads one image from a table by index, copies a 40000-byte buffer, and XORs each byte with the byte forty positions before it across about 39,960 positions.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1C3C
name: save_display_state_snapshot
description: Copies two pointers, four 16-bit fields and a buffer pointer from the working block into a saved-state area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1C6E
name: restore_display_state_snapshot
description: Copies the saved pointers, four 16-bit fields and buffer pointer from the saved-state area back into the working block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1CA0
name: save_display_state_alternate
description: Copies the same pointers and fields from the working block into a second saved-state area at different offsets.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1CD2
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1D0C
name: build_sprite_frame_table
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of image pointers, records each one's address and size in the frame table, and XOR-combines five bitplanes of each image into the buffer. Advances the table and buffer pointers when finished.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:1E60
name: build_frame_sprite_tables
description: Loads an image, marks which of 256 cell codes are used, numbers the used codes, and writes a table of cell records with their offsets and sizes into the buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:21F6
name: shift_frame_table_entries
description: Removes one frame's entries from a table and shifts the remaining records down, adjusting stored offsets by the amount removed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:22BC
name: compact_frame_table_entries
description: Compacts a frame table after one frame's cells are dropped, moving the remaining cell lists down and adjusting their stored offsets and counts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2412
name: copy_frame_cells_with_offset
description: Copies frame cell lists from a source list into a destination, subtracting a delta from each cell value, and adjusts the stored offset of each moved list. Updates the count of cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:243A
name: move_frame_records_down
description: Adjusts stored record offsets by a delta, moves the block of 8-byte frame records from the source slot into the target slot, and reduces the total record count by the difference.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:245E
name: shift_frame_records_and_count
description: Subtracts a fixed delta from the record offsets, moves the block of 8-byte frame records into the target slot, and reduces the total record count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:24D6
name: reduce_frame_record_count
description: Reduces the total record count by the number of entries that the selected slot held.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:24FE
name: set_up_slot_index_table
description: Marks a slot active and records its pointers and size, fills a list of indexes up to the slot's count with a terminator, passes the list to another routine, then records the new pointers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:25E6
name: reserve_slot_buffer
description: Marks a slot active, records the current buffer pointer for it, calls a library routine, and advances the buffer pointer by a size from another routine, rounded up to an even count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2654
name: load_next_piece_images
description: Works out the free buffer space, marks the cell codes needed by the current piece lists, and loads matching piece images into free slots. Draws the chosen images through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2766
name: mark_needed_cells_and_load
description: Marks the cell codes used by one piece list, then loads images into free slots while space remains, and draws two side images through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:27AE
name: load_images_into_free_slots
description: Loads images into free slots while the remaining buffer space allows, then draws two side images through library calls and updates the free-space counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2844
name: load_piece_images_or_report
description: Loads piece images into free slots and draws them through library calls while space allows. When no slot is free it reports the error text not enough memory through another routine and then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2850
name: load_piece_images_into_slots
description: Loops over free buffer slots, loading piece images and drawing them through library calls while space allows. When no slot can be found it calls a routine that reports the error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2870
name: load_one_piece_image_slot
description: Loads one piece image into a free slot, draws it and its side images through library calls, and clears the marks for the piece codes that were loaded.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2A3E
name: store_free_slot_or_report
description: Stores its argument at the next free position of a four-entry stack in the working block. When the stack is full it calls a routine that reports error 104.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:2A6E
name: pop_slot_or_report_error
description: Takes the next value from a four-entry stack and returns it, or calls a routine that reports an error when the stack is empty.
